summary: Researches Sam's Club's catalog — department/category navigation, category product grids, product detail with pricing/availability/ratings, related-item shelves, and curated content pages — using the Crawlora API, returning clean JSON. Use when the user asks to browse Sam's Club departments, list a Sam's Club category's products, look up a Sam's Club product's price/rating, or find items related to a Sam's Club product — instead of scraping samsclub.com.
